```{r import datasets, include=FALSE}
# Combine Tables
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_V0, table_lum_CarTrans_V1, table_lum_CarTrans_V2, table_lum_CarTrans_V3, table_lum_CarTrans_V4, table_lum_CarTrans_V5, table_lum_CarTrans_VX, table_lum_healthy)%>%
mutate(across(-c(Study_ID, Visit, ISHLT_1990, ISHLT_2004, Class_Sup), ~{
        x <- as.numeric(as.character(.))

```

```{r clean overall table, include=FALSE}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(
    !(Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-16", "CarTrans-Long-23", "CarTrans-Long-36") &
      str_detect(Visit, "^VX")))%>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -ISHLT_2004, -Class_Sup, -Transplantation_risk)
```

```{r prep metadata, include=FALSE}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))

# Create annotation table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))

list_Timepoint <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Visit, Timepoint)

 list_Timepoint$Timepoint = factor(list_Timepoint$Timepoint,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "Rejection Context")) 

rownames(list_Timepoint) <- list_Timepoint$Sample_ID
list_Timepoint <- list_Timepoint[, c("Timepoint"), drop = FALSE] 
```

# Grem2

# PD-L1
```{r}
#Prep dataframe
df_pdl1 <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  dplyr::select(Study_ID, Timepoint, Visit, PD_L1)

```


```{r boxplot PD_L1 per patient timpoint, fig.width=9, fig.height=12, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(df_pdl1, aes(x = Visit, y = PD_L1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color=Study_ID), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PD_L1 per patient",
    x = "",
    y = "PD L1 (pg/ml)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Statistische Auswertung

```{r}
ggplot(df_pdl1, aes(x = PD_L1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "PD-L1", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
```


Vergleich vs Healthy: different set of patients and healthy probands - unpaired test with wilcox-test

```{r}
res_vs_healthy <- df_pdl1 %>%
  wilcox_test(PD_L1 ~ Timepoint, ref.group = "Healthy") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

print(res_vs_healthy)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_pdl1, aes(x = Timepoint, y = PD_L1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill="lightcoral") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color="black"), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = res_vs_healthy,
            aes(x = group2, y = max(df_pdl1$PD_L1, na.rm = TRUE) * 2, label = p.adj.signif),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PD_L1 vs Healthy",
    x = "",
    y = "PD L1 (pg/ml)",
    caption = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test vs Healthy, BH-adjusted"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```


Vergleich vs Baseline: same set of patients- paired wilcox test used
```{r}
res_vs_baseline <- df_pdl1 %>%
  filter(Timepoint != "Healthy") %>%
  group_by(Study_ID, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(PD_L1 = mean(PD_L1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = PD_L1) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Study_ID, Baseline), names_to = "Timepoint", values_to = "PD_L1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Baseline), !is.na(PD_L1)) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = levels(df_pdl1$Timepoint))) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(),
            median_change = median(PD_L1 - Baseline),
            p = wilcox.test(PD_L1, Baseline, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

print(res_vs_baseline)
```
```{r}
ggplot(filter(df_pdl1, Timepoint != "Healthy"), aes(x = Timepoint, y = PD_L1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill="lightcoral") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = "black"), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = res_vs_baseline,
            aes(x = Timepoint, y = max(df_pdl1$PD_L1, na.rm = TRUE) * 2, label = p.adj.signif),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PD_L1 vs Baseline",
    x = "",
    y = "PD L1 (pg/ml)",
    caption = "Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test vs Baseline, BH-adjusted"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
res_followups <- df_pdl1 %>%
  filter(!Timepoint %in% c("Healthy", "Baseline")) %>%
  group_by(Study_ID, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(PD_L1 = mean(PD_L1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  {inner_join(., ., by = "Study_ID", suffix = c(".1", ".2"), relationship = "many-to-many")} %>%
  filter(as.integer(Timepoint.1) < as.integer(Timepoint.2)) %>%
  group_by(group1 = as.character(Timepoint.1), group2 = as.character(Timepoint.2)) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(),
            median_change = median(PD_L1.2 - PD_L1.1),
            p = wilcox.test(PD_L1.2, PD_L1.1, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

print(res_followups)
```



```{r , fig.width=8, fig.height=7.5, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(filter(df_pdl1, !Timepoint %in% c("Healthy", "Baseline")), aes(x = Timepoint, y = PD_L1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill="lightcoral") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = "black"), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    res_followups %>%
      filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
      mutate(y.position = max(df_pdl1$PD_L1, na.rm = TRUE) * (1 +0.05 * row_number())),
    label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PD_L1 between follow-up visits",
    x = "",
    y = "PD L1 (pg/ml)",
    caption = "Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, BH-adjusted"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```
